_note: The ONLY place the numbers in the 'Your pre-order offer' box (and the Full Stack pre-order button label) are set. For each page: 'retail' is the list price, 'price' is today's price. Total value = retail + scooper + shipping; the code price = price minus the code percent. shippingValue is a PLACEHOLDER until confirmed. 'scooper': whether that page shows the free Travel Scooper gift (and counts its value). 'summary': whether the Limited-time offer line shows the prices and the Save tag next to the pill (otherwise only the centered pill). 'heading': the text of the green pill at the top of the offer box. 'headingPill': true = the heading is the green pill and the price line has no pill; false = plain heading and a 'Limited-time offer' pill at the left of the price line. 'dynamic': the numbers on the price line are filled in live by src/system-builder.js from the pods chosen (Build Your System). 'scooper': 'dynamic' = the gift band only shows when the system includes a Powder Pod.
